capabilities.description: Ingest and index the contract's conditions of contract, priced BoQ/schedule of rates, variations register, and valuation rules, and answer QS/engineer/accounts/contractor questions strictly from those documents with citations rather than inventing terms.

Build progress-claim line items from measured works / BOQ schedule line items against the contract's priced bill, apply the contract's valuation rules, and roll the valued items into a payment certificate with line-level detail.

Enforce the QS-certifies → contract administrator/engineer-approves → accounts-records-payment chain on each payment certificate, with role-based access for internal staff and contractor users and an auditable trail of each step.

Hold a contract-defined percentage of each payment certificate until the retention cap, release 50% at practical completion, and automatically release the remaining 50% when the 12-month defects-liability period ends — with no extra sign-off step — ahead of UAE 5% VAT treatment of certificates and a

Apply the contract's fixed daily delay-damages rate against the contractual completion date, track elapsed delay, and cap total delay damages at the contract's stated cap; surface the calculation to QS, engineer, and accounts for inclusion in the certificate.

Let external contractor users log in, view the payment certificate line by line, and raise a dispute on individual line items before certification; route each dispute to the QS/engineer, capture respondent reasoning, and record the resolution against the line item.
